titlebar.back.description: Editor title bar: the back button's name and tooltip.

titlebar.name.description: Editor title bar: the accessible name of the field with the recording's name.

titlebar.versionsTitle.description: Editor title bar: tooltip of Versions; its shortcut follows in brackets.

titlebar.versions.description: Editor title bar: button that opens the versions of this edit.

titlebar.commandsTitle.description: Editor title bar: tooltip of Commands; its shortcut follows in brackets.

titlebar.commands.description: Editor title bar: button that opens the command palette.

titlebar.polish.description: Editor title bar: button that opens Polish in one click.

titlebar.publishTitle.description: Editor title bar: tooltip of Publish; its shortcut follows in brackets.

titlebar.publish.description: Editor title bar: button that opens the publishing copy pack.

titlebar.guideTitle.description: Editor title bar: tooltip of Guide; its shortcut follows in brackets.

titlebar.guide.description: Editor title bar: button that opens the step-by-step guide panel.

titlebar.exportTitle.description: Editor title bar: tooltip of Export; its shortcut follows in brackets.

titlebar.export.description: Editor title bar: button that opens the export dialog.

media.loadFailed.description: A video could not be loaded for the preview, an export or a still; {reason} is the video element's own error, in English, or editor.media.unknownError.

media.readFailed.description: A video could not be read at a time asked for; {reason} is the video element's own error, in English, or editor.media.unknownError.

media.unknownError.description: The reason inside "Could not load video (…)" when the video element gives none.

media.imageFailed.description: An image (a background, a pasted or brand image) could not be loaded.

freeze.atEndPauses.description: Editor notice: a freeze frame at the end of the video cannot keep the sound playing.

freeze.onePaused.description: Editor notice after switching one freeze frame to pause the sound.

freeze.onePlaying.description: Editor notice after switching one freeze frame to keep the sound playing.

click.kind.description: Zoom › Selected click and the timeline: which mouse button a recorded click was.

click.stray.start.description: Zoom panel: why stray-click detection ignored a click, as the end of "It was ignored automatically: {reason}." (lower case, no full stop).

click.stray.end.description: Zoom panel: why stray-click detection ignored a click, as the end of a sentence (see editor.click.stray.start).

click.stray.moving.description: Zoom panel: why stray-click detection ignored a click, as the end of a sentence (see editor.click.stray.start).

click.tooltip.strayStart.description: Timeline: a click marker's tooltip when detection ignored the click; {at} is its time.

click.tooltip.strayEnd.description: Timeline: a click marker's tooltip when detection ignored the click; {at} is its time.

click.tooltip.strayMoving.description: Timeline: a click marker's tooltip when detection ignored the click; {at} is its time.

click.tooltip.ignored.description: Timeline: a click marker's tooltip when the user ignored the click; {at} is its time.

click.tooltip.usedKey.description: Timeline: a used click marker's tooltip; {at} is its time, {key} the Delete selection shortcut as keycaps; zoom "yes" when the click can start a zoom.

click.tooltip.used.description: Timeline: a used click marker's tooltip when no key ignores clicks; {at} is its time; zoom "yes" when the click can start a zoom.

click.usedZoom.description: Zoom › Selected click: what a used click that can start a zoom does.

click.used.description: Zoom › Selected click: what a used click that cannot start a zoom does.

click.usedRight.description: Zoom › Selected click: what a used right click does while right clicks start no zoom. "Auto zoom › Right clicks" names a setting in the Zoom panel.

crop.croppedTo.description: Crop: the notice after Done; {width} and {height} are the visible picture's size in pixels.

crop.whole.description: Crop: the notice after Done when no crop is left.

crop.zoomsRemoved.description: Crop: a sentence of the notice after Done; "it" is the crop.

crop.zoomsAdjusted.description: Crop: a sentence of the notice after Done.

crop.zoomsBack.description: Crop: a sentence of the notice after Done (a wider crop shows clicks again).

crop.item.zooms.description: Crop: one item of {list} in editor.crop.outside.

crop.item.shapes.description: Crop: one item of {list} in editor.crop.outside.

crop.item.spotlights.description: Crop: one item of {list} in editor.crop.outside.

crop.outside.description: Crop: a sentence of the notice after Done; {list} is editor.crop.item.* joined as a list, count the items in all.

paste.skip.outside.description: Paste or Duplicate: why items were left out, one fact of {reasons}; what is a counted kind (style.groupEdit.count.*, e.g. "2 zooms"), count how many.

paste.skip.taken.description: Paste or Duplicate: why items were left out (the same item is already at that time), one fact of {reasons}; what is a counted kind (style.groupEdit.count.*, e.g. "2 zooms"), count how many.

paste.skip.atEnd.description: Paste or Duplicate: why chapters were left out, one fact of {reasons}; what is a counted kind (style.groupEdit.count.*, e.g. "2 zooms"), count how many.

paste.skip.inCut.description: Paste or Duplicate: why freeze frames were left out, one fact of {reasons}; what is a counted kind (style.groupEdit.count.*, e.g. "2 zooms"), count how many.

paste.skip.frozen.description: Paste or Duplicate: why freeze frames were left out, one fact of {reasons}; what is a counted kind (style.groupEdit.count.*, e.g. "2 zooms"), count how many.

paste.skip.full.description: Paste or Duplicate: why items were left out (the video holds at most {max} of them), one fact of {reasons}; what is a counted kind (style.groupEdit.count.*, e.g. "2 zooms"), count how many.

paste.skip.otherRecording.description: Paste or Duplicate: why freeze frames or images were left out (copied from another project's recording), one fact of {reasons}; what is a counted kind (style.groupEdit.count.*, e.g. "2 zooms"), count how many.

paste.all.description: Paste: the notice when every item was pasted.

paste.allMoved.description: Paste: the notice when every item was pasted; {at} is the time they were placed, moved back from the playhead so they fit.

paste.some.description: Paste: the notice when {n} of {total} items were pasted.

paste.someMoved.description: Paste: the notice when {n} of {total} items were pasted; {at} is the time they were placed, moved back from the playhead so they fit.

paste.someWhy.description: Paste: the notice when {n} of {total} items were pasted; reasons is editor.paste.skip.* facts with commas between them.

paste.someMovedWhy.description: Paste: the notice when {n} of {total} items were pasted; {at} is the time they were placed, moved back from the playhead so they fit; reasons is editor.paste.skip.* facts with commas between them.

paste.none.description: Paste: the notice when no item could be pasted.

paste.noneWhy.description: Paste: the notice when no item could be pasted; reasons is editor.paste.skip.* facts with commas between them.

duplicate.all.description: Duplicate: the notice when every item was duplicated.

duplicate.allMoved.description: Duplicate: the notice when every item was duplicated; {at} is the time they were placed, moved back from the playhead so they fit.

duplicate.some.description: Duplicate: the notice when {n} of {total} items were duplicated.

duplicate.someMoved.description: Duplicate: the notice when {n} of {total} items were duplicated; {at} is the time they were placed, moved back from the playhead so they fit.

duplicate.someWhy.description: Duplicate: the notice when {n} of {total} items were duplicated; reasons is editor.paste.skip.* facts with commas between them.

duplicate.someMovedWhy.description: Duplicate: the notice when {n} of {total} items were duplicated; {at} is the time they were placed, moved back from the playhead so they fit; reasons is editor.paste.skip.* facts with commas between them.

duplicate.none.description: Duplicate: the notice when no item could be duplicated.

duplicate.noneWhy.description: Duplicate: the notice when no item could be duplicated; reasons is editor.paste.skip.* facts with commas between them.

paste.shortened.description: Paste or Duplicate: one more fact after a middle dot in the notice, the zooms made shorter so they fit.

preview.focusHint.lead.description: Preview: hint while choosing where a zoom looks; a Done button follows. English shows it in pieces as before (a merge group, output-and-languages §9.3); other languages show only the group’s .whole message.

preview.regionHint.lead.description: Preview: hint while drawing a region zoom; a Done button follows. Shift is a keycap. English shows it in pieces as before (a merge group, output-and-languages §9.3); other languages show only the group’s .whole message.

preview.focusHint.whole.description: Preview: the hint while a zoom's focus is picked; <link> is the Done button that ends picking. Used only when the UI language is not English (merge group, output-and-languages §9.3): English builds the same sentence from its pieces.

preview.regionHint.whole.description: Preview: the hint while a zoom's area is drawn; <link> is the Done button that ends drawing. Used only when the UI language is not English (merge group, output-and-languages §9.3): English builds the same sentence from its pieces.

look.colour.natural.description: Colour › Look: the name of the built-in colour look "natural", on its chip and in the strength slider's name.

look.colour.warm.description: Colour › Look: the name of the built-in colour look "warm", on its chip and in the strength slider's name.

look.colour.cool.description: Colour › Look: the name of the built-in colour look "cool", on its chip and in the strength slider's name.

look.colour.vivid.description: Colour › Look: the name of the built-in colour look "vivid", on its chip and in the strength slider's name.

look.colour.soft.description: Colour › Look: the name of the built-in colour look "soft", on its chip and in the strength slider's name.

look.colour.cinematic.description: Colour › Look: the name of the built-in colour look "cinematic", on its chip and in the strength slider's name.

look.colour.mono.description: Colour › Look: the name of the built-in colour look "mono" (black and white), on its chip and in the strength slider's name.

look.colour.vintage.description: Colour › Look: the name of the built-in colour look "vintage", on its chip and in the strength slider's name.
